title: Astro Editor theme
description: A colour theme for Astro Editor. Tokens you leave out use the Default theme.

id.description: A short unique name: lower-case letters, numbers, dashes.

appearance.description: Where the theme can be picked: light mode, dark mode, or either.

oneOf.description: Any CSS colour: #rrggbb, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), a colour name, or a var() of another token.
Different values for light and dark mode.

light.description: Any CSS colour: #rrggbb, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), a colour name, or a var() of another token.

dark.description: Any CSS colour: #rrggbb, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), a colour name, or a var() of another token.
